comparison.objective: Unscrew capped needles from syringes without exposing the needles; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual counterhold, fine relative rotation and axial withdrawal while preserving a friction-fit cap versus counterhold, setscrew tool use and collar rotation.
comparison.success_condition: Needles fully unscrewed and still capped, optionally placed in a tray, versus two safe stops and post-lock setting retention.
comparison.reason: This shares counterholding and fine rotation, but tests safe disassembly of threaded medical connectors, not iterative dynamic commissioning. Candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload, drift and torque thresholds.
